core_obligations: Choose a surjective etale U -> F and pass to U' -> F' (proof lines 3159-3162).
Identify the two induced morphisms of schemes as the same morphism viewed over different bases (proof lines 3163-3169).
Apply the criterion for properties of representable morphisms to conclude the equivalence (proof lines 3170-3171).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for S -> S' a morphism of a big fppf site, F an algebraic space over S, T a scheme over S with f : T -> F, and f' : T' -> F' the morphism over S' obtained by the equivalence of categories of algebraic spaces, every property P of the relative-representable-property type satisfies P(f') if and only if P(f) (source lines 3143-3156). The proof chooses a surjective etale U -> F, notes that U' -> F' is again surjective and etale, and identifies T x_{f,F} U -> U with T' x_{f',F'} U' -> U' - the same morphism of schemes viewed over different bases - so that the criterion for properties of representable morphisms applies.
